_what: Names CLAUDE.md states that are correctly absent from this product. Each is accepted for a reason given below, not because the check was inconvenient.
_rule: Only add an entry here when the name is genuinely NOT a claim about MineLink. If CLAUDE.md refers to something of ours that does not exist, fix the documentation instead — that is the whole point of this check.
_canary: claims_check_corpus_canary_do_not_remove — this string exists ONLY in this file. claims_check.py --selftest asserts it is absent from the searched corpus, which proves baseline files are still excluded from it. Without that exclusion every entry below would satisfy the check it exists to excuse, simply by naming it.
